format_prompt_delta: append delivery override; original semantic instructions and frozen rubric unchanged
valid_delivery: Exactly one submit_audit tool call, natural tool_calls end, complete usage, no content; full original local schema, source quotes and preliminary-score links pass.
failure_policy: First technical/binding/identity/usage failure or insufficient liability headroom stops; no retry, no fallback, no repair.
model_semantic_errors: Record and continue original remaining list; no score correction or seventh request.
comparison_limits: Old V3_OFF r1 vs new r2 crosses delivery interface and is not same-configuration repeat reliability.
Old 06B r1 failed; new r2 cannot retroactively make a complete valid repeat pair.
Historical joint scores are reused, not contemporaneous new A scores.
Completing six slots does not make original strict full repeated-target advancement criterion satisfied.

decisions.delivery_failure: Record failure and stop; preserve responsibility; do not switch thinking/model/endpoint or ask again on same request.
decisions.target_and_controls_supported: Local engineering/semantic mechanism evidence only; preserve unresolved q/severity boundaries and proposal for next independent validation, no automatic qualification.
decisions.target_missed_or_false_accusations: Do not enable automatic routing; localize evidence use or score mapping with existing outputs; no new prompt or sampling.
decisions.ambiguous_or_missing: Inconclusive; unknown remains missing. No repaired rewards, zero imputation or selective exclusion.
